d.seg: मैं बता सकती हूँ आप एक्चुअली मैं वाटसअप पर वीडियो कॉल्स वगैरह करती हूँ चार्जेस लेकर
d.tr: I can tell you actually I do video calls on WhatsApp with charges
d.ctx: The user asked a general question, and the expert transitioned to offering services on WhatsApp.
d.j: Proposing to move to a named external app (WhatsApp) and asking for charges.

d.seg: क्या मैं ओपन वीडियो कॉल्स वगैरह करती हूँ चार्जेस लेकर आप करोगे
d.tr: I do open video calls taking charges, will you do it?
d.ctx: The expert offered WhatsApp calls, then mentioned taking charges for open video calls.
d.j: A price or payment linked to an open or sexual video call.
